info.name: Voice Notes — Third-party Read API
info.description: Read-only API checks for saved voice-feedback records. Configure a dedicated THIRD_PARTY_API_TOKEN on the backend; no database credentials or real tokens are stored in this collection.

exec: pm.test('returns 200 JSON', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.response.to.be.json; });
const body = pm.response.json();
pm.test('contains records and pagination', () => { pm.expect(body.records).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(body.pagination.total).to.be.a('number'); });

if (body.records.length) { pm.collectionVariables.set('record_id', String(body.records[0].id)); const withAudio = body.records.find((row) => row.has_audio); if (withAudio) pm.collectionVariables.set('audio_record_id', String(withAudio.id)); }
pm.test('returns 200 and at most one row', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().records.length).to.be.at.most(1); });
pm.test('reports requested pagination', () => { const p = pm.response.json().pagination; pm.expect(p.limit).to.eql(1); pm.expect(p.offset).to.eql(0); });
pm.test('returns only upload records', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.response.json().records.forEach((row) => pm.expect(row.source).to.eql('upload')); });
pm.test('returns only completed records', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.response.json().records.forEach((row) => pm.expect(row.transcription_status).to.eql('completed')); });

pm.test('matches both filters', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.response.json().records.forEach((row) => { pm.expect(row.source).to.eql('whatsapp'); pm.expect(row.transcription_status).to.eql('completed'); }); });

item.name: 6. Filter by UTC time range (last seven days)

exec: const until = new Date(); const since = new Date(Date.now() - 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
pm.collectionVariables.set('since', since.toISOString()); pm.collectionVariables.set('until', until.toISOString());

pm.test('returns records within the requested time range', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const start = Date.parse(pm.collectionVariables.get('since')); const end = Date.parse(pm.collectionVariables.get('until')); pm.response.json().records.forEach((row) => { const created = Date.parse(row.created_time); pm.expect(created).to.be.at.least(start); pm.expect(created).to.be.at.most(end); }); });
pm.test('returns the requested record', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(String(pm.response.json().record.id)).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('record_id')); });
pm.test('returns saved audio', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Content-Type')).to.match(/^(audio\/|application\/octet-stream)/); });
pm.test('unknown record returns 404', () => pm.response.to.have.status(404));
pm.test('unknown audio returns 404', () => pm.response.to.have.status(404));
pm.test('missing token returns 401 when backend token is configured', () => pm.response.to.have.status(401));
pm.test('incorrect token returns 401', () => pm.response.to.have.status(401));

item.name: 13. APP_ACCESS_TOKEN cannot authenticate to third-party API

exec: pm.test('app token is rejected on third-party API', () => pm.response.to.have.status(401));

item.name: 14. THIRD_PARTY_API_TOKEN cannot authenticate to app API

exec: pm.test('third-party token is rejected on app API', () => pm.response.to.have.status(401));
pm.test('invalid source returns 400', () => pm.response.to.have.status(400));
pm.test('out-of-range limit returns 400', () => pm.response.to.have.status(400));
pm.test('timezone-less timestamp returns 422', () => pm.response.to.have.status(422));
pm.test('reversed time range returns 422', () => pm.response.to.have.status(422));
pm.test('POST to read endpoint returns 405', () => pm.response.to.have.status(405));
pm.test('arbitrary SQL route does not exist', () => pm.response.to.have.status(404));

item.name: 21. Optional: backend token is not configured (isolated staging only)

exec: pm.test('missing backend token configuration returns 503', () => pm.response.to.have.status(503));
